nodes.description: Owner address state variable of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender in constructor and updated by transferOwnership.
Public totalSupply state variable declared in the ERC20 base contract and set by the DRF constructor.
balances mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the DRF constructor.
allowed mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing spend allowances, written by approve and transferFrom.
Boolean flag guarding transfers via the canTransfer modifier, toggled by setTransferable.
Public token name string of the DRF token, set to DragonFruit at declaration.
Public token symbol string of the DRF token, set to DRF at declaration.
Public decimals value of the DRF token, fixed at 18.
Immutable supply cap of the DRF token, computed as 91 million * 10**18.
Owned constructor that assigns the deployer address (msg.sender) as the contract owner.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership of the contract to a new address _owner.
onlyOwner function enabling or disabling token transfers by writing the transferable flag.
Public canTransfer function moving _value tokens from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath sub/add.
Public view function returning the token balance of a given address.
Public canTransfer function moving tokens from _from to _to using the caller's allowance.
Public function granting _spender an allowance of _value, reverting on non-zero to non-zero changes.
Public view function returning the remaining allowance of _spender for _owner.
Payable fallback function of ERC20Token that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain Ether transfers.
DRF constructor minting the full totalSupplyCap to the _issuer address and emitting a Transfer event.
SafeMath library function performing checked subtraction with an assert on underflow.
SafeMath library function performing checked addition with an assert on overflow.
SafeMath library function performing checked multiplication with an overflow assert.
SafeMath library function performing division guarded by an assert on a zero divisor.
Caller-controlled address used for authentication, balance ownership and allowance lookup.
Balances subtraction inside transfer at risk of arithmetic issues if the balance check fails.
Balances addition inside transfer that could overflow without SafeMath protection.
Balances subtraction of _from inside transferFrom, arithmetic-sensitive operation.
Balances addition of _to inside transferFrom, arithmetic-sensitive operation.
Allowance subtraction for the spender inside transferFrom, arithmetic-sensitive operation.
Direct allowance assignment in approve, exposed to the classic approve race condition.
Input parameter _owner of transferOwnership, the new owner address.
Input parameter _transferable of setTransferable, the new flag value.
Input parameter _to of transfer, the destination address.
Input parameter _value of transfer, the amount of tokens to move.
Input parameter _owner of balanceOf, the queried address.
Input parameter _from of transferFrom, the source address.
Input parameter _to of transferFrom, the destination address.
Input parameter _value of transferFrom, the amount of tokens to move.
Input parameter _spender of approve, the address receiving the allowance.
Input parameter _value of approve, the allowance amount.
Input parameter _owner of allowance, the token owner address.
Input parameter _spender of allowance, the spender address.
Input parameter _issuer of the DRF constructor, the address receiving the initial supply.
First uint256 operand a shared by the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Second uint256 operand b shared by the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Local variable c holding the product a * b inside SafeMath.mul.
Local variable c holding the quotient a / b inside SafeMath.div.
Local variable c holding the sum a + b inside SafeMath.add.
Named return local variable balance of balanceOf.

edges.reason: Owned constructor writes owner with the deployer address.
msg.sender is the value assigned to owner during construction.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender equalling owner.
transferOwnership overwrites the privileged owner state variable.
Parameter _owner flows into the new owner assignment.
onlyOwner modifier gates setTransferable on the caller identity.
setTransferable writes the transferable flag.
Parameter _transferable is stored into the transferable flag.
transfer reads and writes balances indexed by msg.sender.
Parameter _to is used as the destination balance key in transfer.
Parameter _value determines the amount moved in transfer.
transfer performs the sender balance subtraction operation.
transfer performs the recipient balance addition operation.
Subtraction result is written back into the balances mapping.
Addition result is written back into the balances mapping.
Parameter _from selects the source balance and allowance in transferFrom.
Parameter _to selects the destination balance in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the amount moved in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes the spender allowance checked in transferFrom.
transferFrom subtracts from the source balance.
transferFrom adds to the destination balance.
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance.
Reduced allowance is stored into the allowed mapping.
Parameter _spender receives the allowance in approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount written by approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approve.
approve writes the allowance mapping entry.
Allowance write targets the allowed mapping.
Parameter _issuer receives the minted supply in the DRF constructor.
DRF constructor sets totalSupply to totalSupplyCap.
DRF constructor credits the issuer balance with the full supply.
Parameter _owner is the lookup key in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the given owner.
Parameter _owner indexes the allowance lookup.
Parameter _spender indexes the allowance lookup.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Operand a is used by SafeMath.sub.
Operand b is used by SafeMath.sub.
Operand a is used by SafeMath.add.
Operand b is used by SafeMath.add.
Operand a is used by SafeMath.mul.
Operand b is used by SafeMath.mul.
Operand a is used by SafeMath.div.
Operand b is used by SafeMath.div.
SafeMath.mul stores the product into local c.
SafeMath.div stores the quotient into local c.
SafeMath.add stores the sum into local c.
balanceOf returns the value through the named return variable balance.
transfer invokes SafeMath.sub for checked subtraction.
transfer invokes SafeMath.add for checked addition.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.sub on balances and allowance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.add for the destination balance.

normalization_plan.reason: The _owner parameter only exists to feed the ownership assignment inside transferOwnership.
The _transferable parameter is only consumed by the transferable flag write in setTransferable.
The _to parameter is only used as the destination key inside transfer.
The _value parameter is only used as the transfer amount inside transfer.
The _owner parameter is only used as the lookup key inside balanceOf.
The _from parameter only selects the source balance and allowance in transferFrom.
The _to parameter only selects the destination balance in transferFrom.
The _value parameter only bounds the amounts moved in transferFrom.
The _spender parameter is only written into the allowance mapping by approve.
The _value parameter is only written into the allowance mapping by approve.
The _owner parameter is only used as the allowance lookup key.
The _spender parameter is only used as the allowance lookup key.
The _issuer parameter is only used to receive the minted supply in the DRF constructor.
Operand a is a generic operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers, represented by the addition helper.
Operand b is a generic operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers, represented by the addition helper.
Local c is the intermediate result computed only inside SafeMath.mul.
Local c is the intermediate result computed only inside SafeMath.div.
Local c is the intermediate result computed only inside SafeMath.add.
The named return variable balance is purely internal to balanceOf.
